title: AI Engineer
description:
Trellis AI is looking for an entry-level AI Engineer to build retrieval-augmented
assistants for enterprise customers. You will work with Python, FastAPI and LangChain,
design evaluation sets, and improve answer quality with prompt engineering and retrieval
tuning.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain RAG pipelines over customer documents using Python and vector databases.
- Ship internal APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic, including tests and structured logging.
- Run evaluations, analyse failure cases and iterate on prompts.
- Work with product and design to turn customer requests into reliable features.

Requirements
- 1+ years of Python experience, ideally with FastAPI or Flask.
- Familiarity with LLMs, embeddings and vector search.
- Solid SQL skills and comfort with Git.
- Based in Islamabad or willing to work hybrid three days per week.

Nice to have: MCP, Docker, Redis, experience with evaluation harnesses.

title: LLM Engineer (Remote)
description:
ByteSpring builds developer tools for AI teams. We are hiring an LLM Engineer to own
our agent runtime: tool calling, context management, memory and safety guardrails.

What you will do
- Design typed tools and MCP servers that connect models to internal systems.
- Improve context assembly, compaction and prompt caching to reduce cost and latency.
- Build guardrails for prompt injection and unsupported claims.
- Instrument traces and evaluate agent behaviour on labelled tasks.

What we expect
- Strong Python and API design skills (FastAPI or similar).
- Hands-on experience with OpenAI models, LangChain or LlamaIndex.
- Understanding of embeddings, SQLite or PostgreSQL, and Docker.
- Clear writing; this role is remote and async-first.

We care about reliability more than model trivia. Salary is benchmarked to your location.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Falcon Analytics turns operational data into forecasting products. Join our ML team to
train, evaluate and deploy models that support supply-chain decisions.

You will
- Build supervised models with scikit-learn and PyTorch on tabular and time-series data.
- Write reproducible pandas pipelines and feature definitions.
- Evaluate models with cross-validation and A/B testing.
- Deploy batch and real-time inference services with FastAPI and Docker.

You bring
- 1-3 years of applied ML experience or a strong portfolio of projects.
- Python, pandas, SQL and Git fluency.
- Ability to explain model trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

Onsite in Lahore with one remote day per week.

title: RAG Engineer
description:
CloudMeadow is a documentation platform used by 4,000 teams. We need an engineer to
make search and question answering excellent across large knowledge bases.

Focus areas
- Chunking, embedding and retrieval strategies using OpenAI embeddings and pgvector.
- Re-ranking and citation quality for generated answers.
- Evaluation with labelled question sets and regression tracking.
- Cost and latency optimisation, including caching and batching.

Requirements
- Python and SQL experience; FastAPI is a plus.
- Familiarity with LangChain or LlamaIndex and at least one vector database.
- You have shipped an LLM feature to real users.

Fully remote. We overlap four hours with CET.

title: Junior Generative AI Developer
description:
Northstar Health is improving how clinicians find internal policy information. This is
an entry-level role for someone who can write clean Python and has built an LLM project
end to end.

You will
- Prototype assistants with Python, OpenAI API and LangChain.
- Help maintain our evaluation harness in pytest.
- Annotate and review outputs with the clinical operations team.
- Fix retrieval bugs and improve prompts using logged failure cases.

Requirements
- BS in Computer Science or equivalent.
- One substantial LLM or ML project you can explain in depth.
- Working knowledge of SQL and Git.
- Understanding of data privacy basics.

Hybrid role in Rawalpindi. Health benefits and a learning budget.

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
Indus Data runs data products for logistics companies. We are looking for an MLOps
Engineer to make model delivery boring and repeatable.

Scope
- Package training and inference code with Docker and CI/CD.
- Operate batch jobs on AWS (S3, ECS) and monitor data drift.
- Build FastAPI inference endpoints with Pydantic validation.
- Improve experiment tracking and model documentation.

Must have
- Python, Linux and Git experience.
- One cloud platform (AWS preferred) and Docker.
- SQL and a habit of writing tests.

Nice to have: Airflow, Kubernetes, PyTorch. Onsite in Karachi, relocation support available.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description:
Karachi Robotics builds inspection software for manufacturing lines. Our next engineer
will improve defect detection models and the pipeline that serves them.

Responsibilities
- Train and evaluate PyTorch vision models on industrial image datasets.
- Build data labelling and augmentation workflows with Python and OpenCV.
- Deploy inference services with FastAPI and Docker.
- Track metrics and error slices with the quality team.

Requirements
- 1+ years of computer vision experience or strong academic projects.
- PyTorch, NumPy and Python proficiency.
- Comfort with Linux and Git.
- Bonus: MLOps, AWS, model quantisation.

Remote within Pakistan with quarterly onsite workshops.

title: AI Engineering Intern
description:
Nexora Labs is hiring two AI Engineering interns for a six-month programme. You will
join the retrieval team and work on real customer deployments.

What you will learn
- Building RAG pipelines with Python, LangChain and vector search.
- Writing FastAPI endpoints with Pydantic schemas.
- Measuring answer quality with small evaluation sets.
- Shipping code through Git and code review.

Requirements
- Final-year CS student or recent graduate.
- Python project experience; LLM coursework or a personal project is a plus.
- Basic SQL and Git.
- Available for a paid internship, three days onsite in Islamabad.

This role is a good fit for candidates with less than one year of professional experience.

title: Python Backend Engineer (AI Products)
description:
Xprolix builds AI content tools used by marketing teams. We need a backend engineer
who enjoys clean APIs and reliable background jobs.

You will
- Build Flask and FastAPI services, backed by PostgreSQL.
- Integrate OpenAI API calls with retries, caching and cost controls.
- Write tests with pytest and ship through GitHub Actions.
- Improve observability with structured logs and traces.

Requirements
- 1-3 years of Python backend experience.
- Strong SQL, Git and testing habits.
- Experience with Docker is a plus.
- Fluent written English for a remote team.

Remote-first, flexible hours, hardware budget.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Apricot Insights helps retailers understand demand. We are adding a data scientist to
our small analytics team.

You will
- Analyse transaction data with Python, pandas and SQL.
- Build forecasting and segmentation models with scikit-learn.
- Present findings with clear charts and recommendations.
- Partner with engineers to productionise models.

Requirements
- 1+ years of analytics experience.
- Statistics fundamentals and A/B testing.
- Python, SQL and Excel.
- Power BI or Tableau is a plus.

Onsite in Islamabad, five days per week.
